body.x: Prolific Design Group(www.epic-id.com), a full-service design and marketing firm, unveiled "EPIC-id" at CES 2015, which runs Jan. 6-9 in Las Vegas.EPIC-id is a USB emergency medical ID wristband created for outdoor enthusiasts, athletes, and people with medical conditions. EMTs, police, and fire fighters will be receiving user's data and access important medical information without the need for a charged phone, passwords or a wi-fi connection. This waterproof device is made of stainless steel. It is PC/Mac compatible and there is no internet connection needed to operate it. Digital emergency forms come pre-loaded on EPIC-id, making it simple to input the personal medical information and make updates as often as necessary.
